scope: Hosted F5 pixel training/prediction/model-file panel and bounded catalog/GL preview. Includes prior native source/pixel workers. Pixel contour publication is later work. Pixel archive records, streaming/resampling, research/TMA and hardware gates remain open.

classifier_benchmark.includes: Native traversal, input snapshot and Python result construction; five sequential calls, no warm-up discarded
classifier_benchmark.excludes: Image access, object features, document edits, GUI and biological validation

object_classifier_benchmark.fixture: Overlapping rectangles with repeated discrete sizes; labels follow side<10. No image reads, cell detection or biological accuracy evidence.
object_classifier_benchmark.timing_scope: One call per phase; capture includes Python ID conversion, classification includes native feature extraction and prediction; publication includes class edit and Python changed-ID construction. Preparation and history policy reported separately; no GUI/hardware budget claim.

classifier_archive_benchmark.scope: One fresh process; one call per phase. Overlapping synthetic rectangles with repeated sizes, 400 training labels and 32 trees/depth 8. Prediction includes feature extraction, inference and archive preparation on worker. Publication includes native class edit, immutable audit insertion and Python changed-ID conversion. Save capture shares immutable artifacts; writer persists objects and archives. Default 64 MiB history, no image reads or biological accuracy evidence. Shared workstation; no hardware/frame-budget acceptance.

verified: halo-tiled labels and vote fractions exactly equal full output
pixel_classifier_benchmark.scope: Synthetic RGB grid; sampled-grid-pixel sigmas, 16 trees/depth4. Three full calls by default and one sequential tiled traversal on a shared workstation. Training uses a subsampled synthetic grid, not biological labels. Work estimates exclude caller RGBA, retained model, Python allocations and process runtime. Tiled timing includes Python slicing/copying, native extraction/inference and stitching. No paired implementation speedup, hardware/frame budget or research accuracy acceptance.

verified: source-tiled labels and vote fractions exactly equal direct buffer
pixel_workflow_benchmark.scope: One observation per phase on a shared workstation, synthetic RGB data and two rectangular labels, level0 calibrated .5/.25um, 128px output tiles, 16 trees/depth4. Source prediction includes decoder calls, context, features, masks and worker reconciliation; direct buffer prediction excludes decoder/capture and uses an already owned full RGBA frame. Work estimates exclude original image, retained model, Python arrays and runtime; no RSS, paired implementation speedup, frame-budget, UI/project-publication or biological accuracy acceptance.

gui_pixel_benchmark.scope: One synthetic observation on shared workstation. Native ImGui buttons start annotation sampling/training and source prediction, followed by real GL preview. Unlabelled cells are outside the fixed camera view; this measures catalog work amid a large object map, not dense visible drawing. Budget counts1024 objects per catalog step and caps preview uploads at four256px tiles/frame. Every mask label is checked; GPU payload is exact for this crop. No biological, UI frame-budget, process RSS or hardware acceptance claim.
